▸ ESP
  • Killer ESP (Red Highlight)
  • Survivor ESP (Green Highlight)
  • Item ESP (Medkit/BloxyCola)
  • Generator ESP (White Highlight)
  • Nexa Hitbox (Minimal Pulsing Ring Visualization)

▸ GENERATOR AUTOMATION
  • Full Map Auto-Fix (Teleport to all generators)
  • Auto-Repair Near (Repairs when within 5 studs)
  • Adjustable Repair Speed & Click Rate
  • Human-like delays for detection avoidance

▸ SURVIVOR COMBAT
  • Auto Block (Distance-based trigger) 70-80% Accurate
  • Double Punch (Block + Punch combo)
  • Auto Punch (Configurable range)
  • Adjustable delays for all combat actions

▸ KILLER COMBAT
  • Auto Attack (Slash nearby survivors)
  • Auto Farm Kills (Stick & Follow mode)
  • Configurable detection range
  • Adjustable stick distance behind target

▸ MOVEMENT SYSTEM
  • Speed (Bypassing their AC)
  • Sprint Boost (Hold Shift for multiplier)
  • Adjustable base speed & sprint ratio
  • Smooth movement

▸ TECHNICAL FEATURES
  • Safe remote handling with error protection
  • No memory leaks or resource overflow
  • Persistent configuration save/load system
  • Cool UI with dark theme and 10+ More
  • Minimize hotkey (Left Control) BUT Change it to another key like K cus pmo fr
